title: Alaska + World Skeleton
description: OpenTopoMap raster tiles. World skeleton z=0-5 (every tile globally) + Alaska statewide z=6-11 (lon -180..-130, lat 51..72). Includes the Aleutian chain. Alaska z=11 is self-rendered with corrected EPSG:3857 hillshade and geographic-DEM contours.

source.name: OpenTopoMap
source.attribution: Map data © OpenStreetMap contributors, SRTM | Map style: © OpenTopoMap (CC-BY-SA)

notes: v1: pack is bundled inside the app. v2+ will host regional packs in iCloud Drive and ship only the world skeleton in the binary. Alaska z=11 self-rendered: hillshade in true EPSG:3857 (AlaskaRouter-lg59); contours from a geographic DEM at 0.001 deg (~90 m), imported via a modern osm2pgsql 1.11 sidecar (osmium sort + single --create) which handles 64-bit node ids natively and removed the contour spidernets that osm2pgsql 1.2.0 produced above ~2^32 (AlaskaRouter-6fop).
